description: Template for dino-bones-{slug} round images. Replace {dinosaur} and {slug} with the dinosaur name and image slug (e.g. trex, triceratops).
clue_options: 1. The scene itself (preparator, paleontologist, tarp, skeleton)
2. Nearly fully articulated skeleton on tarp, one bone missing
3. Gift fossil bone partially encased in matrix rock—enough visible to identify, clearly missing from skeleton
4. Skeleton skull unmounted but clearly visible on tarp
5. Obvious missing bone: skull (small dino), foreleg (small/medium), femur (big dino)
template_prompt: Museum preparator office. Light tarp on floor. Preparator sitting to one side. Paleontologist with gift fossil (partially in matrix). Nearly complete {dinosaur} skeleton on tarp. One obvious bone missing—[choose: skull / foreleg / femur / etc. based on dinosaur size]. Enough of the skeleton and/or gift fossil visible for a child to identify the dinosaur.
